title_zh: 📢 游戏守则 5.1.0：11 月 28 日起新投稿须接入 SDK
title_en: 📢 Game Rules 5.1.0: SDK Required for New Submissions from Nov 28
content_zh:
《了了了游游戏守则》升级至 5.1.0，将于 2026 年 11 月 28 日正式生效。

核心变化：自 11 月 28 日起新投稿的游戏，须接入了了了游开发者 SDK（至少实现 submitScore 分数上报），以便平台统一展示全服榜单、评分与成绩分享。此前 5.0.0 版要求的三项法律协议（用户协议/隐私政策/服务条款）继续有效。

已收录的游戏不受新条款约束。接入方式见开发者 SDK 文档（sdk-docs.html）。
content_en:
lelele Game Rules upgraded to 5.1.0, effective November 28, 2026.

Key change: games newly submitted from Nov 28 must integrate the lelele Game Developer SDK (at minimum submitScore), enabling unified leaderboards, ratings and score sharing. The 5.0.0 requirement for all three legal agreements (EULA / Privacy Policy / Terms of Service) remains in effect.

Already-indexed games are unaffected. See the Developer SDK docs (sdk-docs.html) for integration.

title_zh: 🎯 站点 4.5.0：猜你喜欢、想玩清单、成绩分享来了！
title_en: 🎯 Site 4.5.0: For You, Watchlist & Score Sharing Are Here!
content_zh:
这次更新让找游戏和回访更顺手：

🎯 首页「猜你喜欢」会参考你的收藏和想玩清单
⏯️ 「继续玩」接着上次的进度
🔖 游戏卡上的书签可加入「想玩清单」
💎 「冷门宝藏榜」发现玩过的人少但评价高的好游戏
🎲 「手气不错」在你当前的筛选范围里随机挑一款
🏷️ 标签专题页按标签聚合游戏
📊 个人中心显示你的本地游玩统计（只在本机，不上传）
🏆 作者页新增「作者贡献榜」
🔗 游戏内可生成带昵称和分数的成绩分享链接

开发者注意：SDK 已升级，新增评分、排行榜读取、相似游戏跳转、成绩分享等能力，文档见 sdk-docs.html。
content_en:
This update makes finding and returning to games easier:

🎯 For You learns from your favorites and watchlist
⏯️ Continue Playing picks up where you left off
🔖 Bookmark games to your Watchlist
💎 Hidden Gems surfaces well-loved games with few plays
🎲 Lucky Pick randomly chooses within your current filter
🏷️ Tag Explorer groups games by tag
📊 Profile shows local play stats (on-device only, never uploaded)
🏆 Author pages gain a Top Contributors board
🔗 Generate shareable result links with your nickname and score

Developers: the SDK is upgraded with ratings, leaderboard reads, similar-game jumps and score sharing. See sdk-docs.html.

content_zh:

🦠 新冠跑酷 —— 跳跃闯关

Eight new games are live on lelele Game - just open and play:

🔢 2048 - the classic number puzzle
🌀 Astray - 3D WebGL maze

title_zh: 🏆 站点 4.4.0：全服高分榜上线，玩游戏就能冲榜！
title_en: 🏆 Site v4.4.0: Global High-Score Leaderboard Is Live!
content_zh:
播放器现在有「全服高分榜 Top 10」啦！点右下角的 🏆 按钮就能看到当前游戏的全服高分。

🎮 怎么玩：支持 SDK 的游戏会在你通关结算时自动上报分数；未登录也能参与，系统会给你一个随机昵称（保存在本地）。

🛠️ 开发者：在游戏里引入 lelele-sdk.js，调用 LeleleSDK.submitScore(分数) 即可接入，无需后端。详见开发者文档。

说明：高分榜为荣誉展示，分数由客户端上报，不做防作弊校验，大家图个开心～
content_en:
The player now has a Global Top 10 leaderboard! Tap the 🏆 button at the bottom right to see the top scores for the game you're playing.

🎮 How it works: games with the SDK report your score automatically at game over. No login needed - a random nickname is generated and kept locally.

🛠️ Developers: add lelele-sdk.js and call LeleleSDK.submitScore(score) to integrate - no backend required. See the developer docs.

Note: this is an honor-system board (client-reported, no anti-cheat) - just for fun!

title_zh: 🎉 站点 4.3.0：标签筛选、收藏分组与开发者数据开放
title_en: 🎉 Site v4.3.0: Tag Filters, Favorite Groups & Open Developer Data
content_zh:
站点升级到 4.3.0，带来一批浏览与创作者相关的新功能：

🏷️ 更好找游戏：首页新增「本周新游与更新」轮播、标签多选筛选、搜索历史，随机游玩也能指定范围。

⭐ 收藏更好用：收藏弹窗支持分组与拖动排序；详情页新增「玩过这个的人也喜欢」相似推荐和长简介折叠；作者页现在能看到作品数、总收藏与最受欢迎作品。

📊 面向开发者：平台开放公开统计 API（无需登录、支持跨域），开发者可在开发者文档看到用法，也可在数据大屏 stats.html 直接查询；我们还提供了 llms.txt，帮助 AI agent 快速理解如何接入与开发游戏，无需阅读我们的源码。

📢 公告弹窗支持已读/未读筛选；收藏榜与游玩榜可导出 CSV、点列头排序。

感谢每一位玩家与开发者，祝玩得开心！
content_en:
Site v4.3.0 is here with a batch of discovery and creator features:

🏷️ Find games faster: a weekly new/updated carousel, multi-select tag filters, search history, and a scope filter for random play.

⭐ Better favorites: group and drag-to-reorder your favorites; game pages now show similar recommendations and collapsible long descriptions; author pages show work count, total favorites and the most-loved title.

📊 For developers: a public stats API (no login, CORS open) documented in the developer guide, a visual dashboard at stats.html, and llms.txt so AI agents can understand how to integrate and build games here without reading our source.

📢 Announcements can be filtered read/unread; leaderboards support CSV export and sortable columns.

Thanks to every player and developer - have fun!

title_zh: 🎉 站点 4.2.0：全新游戏播放器、收藏榜与宣传视频
title_en: 🎉 Site v4.2.0: New Player, Favorites Leaderboard & Promo Video
content_zh:
站点升级到 4.2.0，带来几项和玩家直接相关的新功能：

🎮 全新独立播放器：在游戏详情页点「开始游戏」，会进入干净的 play.html 播放器窗口，游戏存档照常保存，全屏只留游戏画面；如果某个游戏不允许被内嵌，我们会提示你在新标签页打开。

⭐ 收藏榜上线：现在可以在「收藏榜」（favgames.html）看到全站玩家最喜爱的游戏排行；首页 Top3 也改成按收藏和游玩综合计算的「排行点」排序，点「查看更多」还能切换总榜、收藏榜、游玩榜。你收藏过的游戏在作品页和作者页都能看到累计收藏数。

🎬 宣传视频：关于页新增平台的宣传视频，YouTube 加载慢时会自动切换到备用视频，国内玩家也能顺畅观看。

🌐 中英双语：播放器外壳、搜索提示、排行榜等细节都补齐了中英适配，切换语言即实时生效。

感谢每一位玩家和开发者的支持，祝玩得开心！
content_en:
Site v4.2.0 is here with several player-facing improvements:

🎮 A brand-new standalone player: hitting "Start Game" on a detail page opens a clean play.html window. Your game saves still work, fullscreen shows only the game, and games that block embedding prompt you to open them in a new tab.

⭐ Favorites leaderboard: see which games the community loves most on the new favorites leaderboard (favgames.html). The homepage Top3 now sorts by "rank points" combining favorites and plays, and "View More" lets you switch between Overall, Favorites and Plays. Favorite counts also show up on game and author pages.

🎬 Promo video: the About page now has a platform trailer that automatically falls back to a mainland-accessible video if YouTube is slow.

🌐 Bilingual polish: the player shell, search placeholder, rankings and more now follow your language switch instantly.

Thanks to every player and developer - have fun!

title_zh: 📜 合规新规：游戏守则 5.0.0 · 所有游戏须具备法律协议
title_en: 📜 Compliance Update: Game Rules v5.0.0 · Legal Agreements Required
content_zh:
《了了了游游戏守则》已更新至 **5.0.0**，自 **2026 年 11 月 15 日** 起正式生效。

⚠️ **新规核心**：所有提交到平台的游戏——无论以链接还是代码形式，也无论是新投稿、推荐、收录还是后续更新——都必须具备「用户协议」「隐私政策」「服务条款」三类法律协议。缺少任一协议的游戏将无法通过审核。

🔗 **外链游戏**：投稿时须分别填写三类协议的 https 可公开访问直链；链接失效或指向无关内容视为未提供。

💾 **代码游戏**：可在游戏内自带协议页面并说明入口；未自带的默认使用平台提供的「万能协议」，由平台在游戏详情页自动挂载，无需开发者额外操作。

📄 **免费模板**：全新上线「协议模板中心」，提供三套中英双语模板，填入游戏名称等信息即可实时预览，一键导出 Markdown / TXT / HTML / PDF / Word 五种格式（基于 Apache License 2.0 开源，须在游戏内保留「本法律条款由了了了游提供」声明）。

🛟 **过渡安排**：新规生效前已收录、尚未提交专属协议的存量游戏，统一自动挂载平台万能协议，不作下架处理；开发者可随时通过后台「更新游戏」表单补齐专属链接。玩家在游戏详情页右侧的三个协议图标，即可查看该游戏适用的协议内容。

📚 历史版本 4.0.0 / 4.0.1 / 4.0.2 均已在「游戏守则」页尾的历史版本索引中留存，可随时查阅。
content_en:
The lelele Game Rules have been updated to **v5.0.0**, effective **November 15, 2026**.

⚠️ **What changes**: every game submitted to the Platform — whether as a link or as source code, whether a new submission, a recommendation, a listing or a later update — must provide an EULA, a Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. A game missing any of them cannot pass review.

🔗 **Link-based games**: provide three separate, publicly accessible https direct URLs in the submission form. Broken or unrelated links are treated as missing.

💾 **Code-based games**: you may include legal pages in-game and state where to find them; otherwise the Platform's generic agreements are mounted automatically on the game detail page, with no extra work required.

📄 **Free templates**: the new Legal Template Center offers three bilingual templates. Fill in your game's details to preview instantly, then export to Markdown / TXT / HTML / PDF / Word (open source under the Apache License 2.0; retain the notice "These legal terms are provided by lelele Game" in-game).

🛟 **Transition**: games already listed before the effective date that have not submitted dedicated agreements automatically use the Platform's generic agreements and will **not** be delisted. Developers may supply dedicated links at any time via "Update a Game" in the dashboard. Players can review the applicable agreements via the three icons on the right edge of each game detail page.

📚 Previous versions 4.0.0 / 4.0.1 / 4.0.2 remain available via the version-history index on the Game Rules page.

title_zh: 🔄 后台「更新游戏」上线 · 游戏守则更新至 4.0.2
title_en: 🔄 Update Your Game is live · Game Rules v4.0.2
content_zh:
本次带来两项更新：

🔄 开发者后台新增「更新游戏」：已登录且名下至少有 1 款游戏的开发者，可在侧栏直接提交新版本号、更新内容、一句话简介、详细玩法说明、新截图或新的游戏链接，中英文各有独立表单，提交后通常 1–2 个工作日内完成核对并同步到游戏详情页。

📜 《了了了游游戏守则》更新至 4.0.2（2026 年 11 月 10 日生效），新增「4.5 收录形式与分类」：凡以链接形式提交并审核通过的游戏一律归为「外网游戏」；以代码形式提交的游戏，在作者无特别说明时默认归为「本站游戏」，因为代码已经过平台检验。作者可特别说明申请不同归类，最终以审核结果为准。历史版本（4.0.0 / 4.0.1）仍可在「游戏守则」页内通过历史版本链接查看（game_rules4-0-0.html / game_rules4-0-1.html）。

感谢各位创作者与玩家的支持！
content_en:
Two updates in this release:

🔄 "Update a Game" is now available in the developer dashboard: signed-in creators with at least one published game can submit a new version number, changelog, one-line summary, detailed gameplay description, new screenshots or a new game URL from the sidebar. Separate Chinese and English forms are provided; submissions are reviewed and synced to the game detail page usually within 1–2 business days.

📜 The Game Rules have been updated to v4.0.2 (effective November 10, 2026) with a new clause "4.5 Submission Format and Category": games submitted as a link and approved are always listed as "External"; games submitted as code are listed as "Local" by default unless the author states otherwise, because the code has been reviewed by the Platform. Authors may explicitly request a different category, and the review outcome is final. Previous versions (4.0.0 / 4.0.1) remain available via the version-history links on the Game Rules page (game_rules4-0-0.html / game_rules4-0-1.html).

Thank you to all creators and players!

title_zh: 🎉 一键登录、服务条款与首页新布局上线！
title_en: 🎉 One-tap Sign-in, Terms of Service & New Homepage Layout!
content_zh:
本次带来三项大更新：

🔐 开发者登录/注册全新支持 Google、GitHub、Discord、GitLab、X (Twitter) 一键登录，还可在后台「账号绑定」中把多个账号关联到一起，任意方式登录都是同一个账号。
📜 全新《服务条款》正式发布（中英双语），注册/登录即代表您同意，可在登录页与全站页脚查看。
🎨 首页改为双栏布局：排行榜与公告移至右侧边栏，不再遮挡游戏列表；公告只显示标题，点击「查看详情」即可查看完整内容。

📱 首次访问还会有全屏引导带你认识新布局（11 月 5 日前），快去体验吧！
content_en:
Three major updates are here:

🔐 Developer sign-in/sign-up now supports one-tap login with Google, GitHub, Discord, GitLab and X (Twitter). You can also link multiple providers in Dashboard → Linked Accounts — any of them signs into the same account.
📜 The bilingual Terms of Service is now published; by signing up/in you agree to it. Find it on the login page and in the site footer.
🎨 The homepage adopts a two-column layout: the ranking and announcements move to the right sidebar and no longer block the game list. Announcements show titles only — click "View Details" to read the full content.

📱 A full-screen guide will walk you through the new layout on your first visit (until Nov 5). Enjoy!

title_zh: 🎯 推荐游戏功能上线！没登录也能推荐好游戏
title_en: 🎯 Recommend a Game is here — no login required!
content_zh:
发现了一款想分享的好游戏？现在可以直接推荐给我们了！

🎯 首页新增「推荐游戏」按钮，点开即填，无需注册登录
📝 中英文表单自动匹配站点语言，手机电脑都能填
⏱️ 提交后 5 个工作日内完成审核，结果会通过邮件通知
🔗 如果点了「投稿」却还没登录，会提示你直接走推荐通道

推荐时请务必确认已获得原作者授权，并填写真实有效的联系方式。审核通过后，游戏就会出现在「了了了游」上，推荐者信息也会一并收录。

感谢每一位愿意分享的你，让摸鱼时光更快乐！
content_en:
Found a great game worth sharing? Now you can recommend it to us directly!

🎯 A new "Recommend" button on the homepage — fill it in without signing up or logging in
📝 The bilingual form follows your site language, and works on both desktop and mobile
⏱️ Submissions are reviewed within 5 business days, and results are sent by email
🔗 Clicked "Submit" without logging in? You will be offered the recommendation channel instead

Please make sure you have the original author's permission and provide valid contact information. Once approved, the game will be listed on lelele Game along with the recommender's credit.

Thanks to everyone who is willing to share — let's make those break-time moments more fun!

title_zh: 🎄 冰雪降临！了了了游冬季限定主题正式开启
title_en: 🎄 Winter is Coming! lelele Game Winter Theme is Live
content_zh:
伴随着初雪，我们的冬季限定主题现已全站上线！活动由10月22日一直到12月31日！

在接下来的日子里，你将体验到：
❄️ 全站飘落的浪漫雪花特效
🏔️ 全新冰雪蓝渐变背景与雪景 Banner
👒 戴上了圣诞帽的特别版 Logo
⛄ 左右下角的盲盒风雪人与圣诞树彩蛋

希望大家在这个冬天，也能在「了了了游」找到温暖与快乐。祝大家冬日愉快！
content_en:
Along with the first snow, our Winter Theme is now live across the entire site!The activity starts from 22 OCT and last to 31 Dec

In the coming days, you will experience:
❄️ Romantic falling snow effects site-wide
🏔️ A brand new ice-blue gradient background and snow scenery banner
👒 A special edition Logo wearing a Santa hat
⛄ Blind-box style snowman and Christmas tree easter eggs in the corners

We hope you find warmth and joy at 'lelele Game' this winter. Happy Winter!

title_zh: 🚀 开发者系统正式上线！3.0.0 版本大更新
title_en: 🚀 Developer System is Live! 3.0.0 Major Update
content_zh: 欢迎使用全新的开发者生态！我们现在支持开发者独立注册、后台数据看板（含环比趋势），以及专属的公开作者主页。想查看您的游戏数据？快去首页点击右上角登录吧！
content_en: Welcome to the new developer ecosystem! We now support independent developer registration, backend dashboards (with trend analysis), and exclusive public author pages. Want to check your game stats? Log in via the top right corner of the homepage!

title_zh: 🔍 智能搜索与全新排版上线啦！
content_zh: 想找游戏但忘了名字？全新上线的拼音搜索、首字母匹配与高亮功能帮你轻松搞定！同时，我们将搜索框移到了顶部导航栏，全站热度榜也搬到了首页更显眼的位置，快去体验吧！
content_en: Forgot the game name? The brand-new pinyin search, initials matching, and highlighting are here to help! We also moved the search bar to the top navigation and placed the Global Ranking higher on the homepage. Try it out!

title_zh: 首页新增全站游戏热度榜
title_en: Homepage added global game popularity rankings
content_zh: 首页现已新增全站游戏热度榜：前三名会突出展示，点击可跳转到对应游戏详情页；查看更多可查看前 25 名排行榜，并支持每 5 分钟自动刷新。
content_en: The homepage now includes a global game popularity ranking: the top three games are highlighted, each links to its detail page, and the full top-25 leaderboard can be opened for a quick view with automatic refresh every 5 minutes.

title_zh: 🌌 纯AI打造硬核新作《星种 Starseed》正式上架！

我们非常高兴地宣布，由纯 AI 构建的全新科幻游戏《星种》现已正式登陆本站游戏专区！ ⚠️ 注意：这款游戏的操作极其硬核，难度直接拉满，极其考验你的极限反应能力与适应能力。 👇 点击下方观看游戏宣传片： 准备好开启地狱级的星际探索之旅了吗？点击下方按钮直接进入游戏：

Click the button below to play:
🎮 Play Starseed Now

title_zh: 🎉 全站焕新升级：深色模式与多项实用功能上线！
title_en: 🎉 Site-Wide Upgrade: Dark Mode & New Practical Features!
content_zh:
1. 🌗 新增全局深色模式，夜间浏览更护眼。
2. 💬 新增右下角全局反馈按钮，随时提建议。
3. 📢 公告系统优化：支持单条公告24小时静音，以及查看全部历史公告。
4. ⬆️ 新增回到顶部按钮，长页面浏览更方便。
5. 📱 支持 PWA 安装，可将了了了游添加到桌面。
6. 🛠️ 统一全站底部导航与语言切换体验，修复了多处视觉细节。
content_en:
1. 🌗 Added global Dark Mode for a more eye-friendly night browsing experience.
2. 💬 Added a global feedback button at the bottom right to share your suggestions anytime.
3. 📢 Optimized announcement system: supports 24-hour mute for individual announcements and viewing all historical announcements.
4. ⬆️ Added a 'Back to Top' button for easier long-page browsing.
5. 📱 PWA support: you can now add lelele Game to your home screen.
6. 🛠️ Unified site-wide footer navigation and language switching experience, and fixed multiple visual details.

title_zh: 了了了游正式上线 & 支持我们
title_en: lelele Game is Live & Support Us
content_zh:
欢迎来到了了了游！我们致力于为你发现更多好玩、有趣的独立游戏。
如果你也是游戏开发者，欢迎点击右上角的「投稿」加入我们。
如果你喜欢了了了游，欢迎通过右上角的「❤️ 支持我们」按钮为我们提供支持。感谢你的认可！
content_en:
Welcome to lelele Game! We are dedicated to discovering more fun and interesting indie games.
If you are a game developer, feel free to click 'Submit' in the top right corner to join us.
If you like lelele Game, welcome to support us via the '❤️ Support Us' button in the top right corner. Thank you!

title_zh: 了了了游游戏守则更新至 4.0.1 版本
title_en: lelele Game Rules Updated to Version 4.0.1
content_zh:
【了了了游游戏守则】已更新至版本 4.0.1，更新内容如下：
1. 纠正了部分法律文件链接的错误
2. 修改了平台在部分业务上的响应时间
3. 优化了一些已知的问题

新的守则正式生效时间为 2026 年 10 月 25 日。在此之前，如有人认为该版本存在不妥，可通过发送邮件至 leleleling@2980.com 进行申诉；申诉审批通过后，将恢复到 4.0.0 版本。
content_en:
The lelele Game Rules have been updated to version 4.0.1. The updates are as follows:
1. Corrected errors in some legal document links.
2. Modified the platform's response times for certain business matters.
3. Optimized some known issues.

The new rules will officially take effect on October 25, 2026. Before then, if anyone believes that any part of this version is inappropriate, they may appeal by sending an email to leleleling@2980.com. After the appeal is approved, the rules will be reverted to version 4.0.0.

title_zh: 📢 致开发者与游戏推荐者的重要通知
title_en: 📢 Important Notice to Developers & Game Recommenders
content_zh:
近期，我们注意到部分开发者在提交游戏作品时，选择了【代码上传】方式，但我们接收到的文件存在不完整或损坏的情况。经过排查，原因多为系统对特定代码格式的排斥，或在上传进度条未完成时提前提交了表单。

对此，我们已对投稿表单做出以下优化调整：
1. 📦 代码提交改为统一上传 zip/rar 压缩包；
2. 📝 新增「单一文件代码粘贴」提交方式，方便小体积代码直接提交；
3. 📧 若压缩包体积过大，请直接发送邮件至官方邮箱进行投递。

💡 温馨提醒：我们在处理您的投稿后会发送邮件通知。请务必留意您的【垃圾邮件箱】，并认准由【了了了岭工作室】发送的官方邮件，以免错过重要信息！
